content.short: YaySwap is a Cardano DeFi project for smart token swaps, native assets, and low-cost decentralized trading.
content.description: YaySwap is a Cardano DeFi project focused on smart swaps for native tokens. The platform presents its goal as making decentralized trading easier and cheaper by using smart-contract-based trade execution instead of centralized intermediaries. As the number of Cardano native assets grows, YaySwap aims to give users a simple way to exchange tokens safely while benefiting from lower costs and blockchain settlement. Its main role is to support Cardano token liquidity and trading access for users too.
